models.title: DTH-HRH overlay 0.1.0-draft.1
models.description: The dth-hrh overlay on the smart-ra (DPI-H RA) ArchiMate model 0.2.0: the health workforce registry with the National Health Workforce Accounts (NHWA) work, which dth-hrh owns (owner, 2026-11-01 20:32Z: NHWA does not belong in smart-ra). Elements tagged overlay:base copy a smart-ra element and name it by IRI; elements tagged overlay:owner=dth-hrh are this DTH's own.
